responsibility: This header defines the `qdf24xx_tunings` model for Qualcomm Falkor/QDF24xx-class cores in the AArch64 backend. It supplies QDF24xx-specific address costs, register-move costs, AdvSIMD vector costs, prefetch settings, issue rate, and fusion mask, forming the dedicated `tune_params` bundle used by instruction costing and scheduling heuristics for that processor family.
